name: scrapfly
description: Scrapfly is a managed web scraping and browser automation platform. One API key gives an agent: anti-bot bypass on 20+ vendors (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai, hCaptcha), residential and datacenter proxies in every country, headless Chromium via REST or driver protocols, full-page screenshots, LLM-powered structured extraction, and a configurable site crawler.

skills.name: Scrape a URL
skills.description: Fetch a single URL through Scrapfly's managed proxy and anti-bot bypass infrastructure, returning the full HTML response or rendered DOM.
examples: Scrape a Cloudflare-protected page using residential proxies in Germany
Get the rendered DOM of a JavaScript-heavy SPA

skills.name: Extract structured data
skills.description: Extract typed structured data from a web page using a JSON schema or natural-language prompt; LLM-grounded with citations back to source HTML.
examples: Extract product name, price, and availability from a product page
Pull the author, publish date, and body from an article
Get all reviews from a Yelp business page as JSON

skills.name: Take a screenshot
skills.description: Capture a full-page, viewport, or element-level screenshot of a live URL.
examples: Take a full-page screenshot of https://example.com

skills.name: Crawl a site
skills.description: Crawl an entire website with configurable budget, depth, URL patterns, and per-page scraping options. Results are streamed via webhook or pulled from a job queue.
examples: Crawl all product pages on https://shop.example.com up to 10,000 URLs
Crawl a site, scrape each page with anti-bot, deliver via webhook

skills.name: Cloud Browser action
skills.description: Drive a remote Chromium session via Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or raw CDP. Supports multi-step flows: login, click, type, evaluate JavaScript.
examples: Log into a site and download a CSV from the dashboard
Solve a multi-step search form and screenshot the results
Run a custom JavaScript scenario and return the page state

apiKey.name: key
apiKey.description: Long-lived API key (scp-live-{32-hex}) issued from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard

additionalInterfaces.description: Direct REST API (Scrape, Screenshot, Extraction, Crawler) — language-agnostic, key-authenticated
Cloud Browser CDP / Playwright / Puppeteer / Selenium connect URL
